title: BaselineRecord
description: Baseline with the VM off: standalone disk plus firmware state, immutable.

config_revision.description: VM configuration revision recorded with the baseline.

disk_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the baseline's disk image.

firmware_sha256.description:
SHA-256 of the baseline's firmware state (NVRAM); `None` for a
firmware without NVRAM (legacy BIOS, ADR-0027).

protected.description: Protected initial baseline: cannot be deleted or replaced by agent tools.

BaselineId.description: BaselineId: version 7 UUID, lowercase with hyphens.

oneOf.description: Recorded after an observed clean shutdown.
Checkpoint materialized from an overlay with the VM off.

Label.description: Text declared by the user, without control characters; never interpreted.

UtcTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with Z suffix, millisecond precision.

VmId.description: VmId: version 7 UUID, lowercase with hyphens.
